name: Image Billboard
description: Placement-side fallback for DNA-gallery findings whose grammar doesn't have a live builder yet. Renders any PNG as a billboarded plane. Used by the promote-to-artifact pipeline when a gallery has no registered builder artifact.
theoreticalGrounding: A snapshot of a finding is still a finding — image_billboard makes uncurated grammars placeable while their live builders catch up.

image_billboard.name: Image Billboard
image_billboard.description: Renders a PNG (typically a curated DNA-gallery screenshot) as a billboarded plane in 3D. Parameters: image_path (required), plane_size, y_offset, billboard_enabled.
image_billboard.qfep_connection: S: a placed reference to a system state — the finding rendered as snapshot rather than recomputed.
